register.labelZh: BLOCK 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: block in 可用來說明車輛或某人為何無法離開。；block off 可用來談論因安全理由而封閉的道路、小徑、房間等地方。；它可表示擋住光線或視線,也可表示嘗試不去想某人或某事。；block up 可用來描述被堵塞或封住的管道、洞口、窗戶或門口。
register.summaryEn: Block in helps you explain why a car or person cannot leave. Block off helps you talk about roads, paths, rooms and other places that are closed for safety. It can describe keeping light or a view away, or trying not to think about someone or something. Block up helps you describe a pipe, hole, window or doorway that has been filled or closed.
